alternatives: Force four publisher levels into three pathways: rejected because Foundation explicitly targets A2 and integrated general language; would hide necessary remediation.
Use Foundation as diagnostic-selected prerequisite support within foundation, then core L1/L2/L3 progression: recommended design inference, subject to teacher validation.

chosen_mapping.foundation: MSF prerequisite microsteps where diagnosis requires them, then MS1 core. Do not assume every foundation learner needs all Foundation material.
chosen_mapping.intermediate: MS2 core; recycle MS1 number/meaning and short-answer fundamentals when demonstrated gaps remain.
chosen_mapping.advanced: MS3 core; keep precise details/form completion rather than equating advanced work solely with abstract tasks.

design.mapping_evidence: Foundation PDF9 explicitly current A2, integrated language/skills and progression into full IELTS course. Series chart gives L1/L2/L3 target bands5.5/6.5/7.5. These are publisher course targets, not entry cutoffs, validated placement or promised learner outcomes.

foundation_listening.train: Teach familiar activity/time vocabulary, speaker roles, number contrasts, corrections and equivalent expressions with replay and explanation.
foundation_listening.transfer: Adapt another source-derived everyday booking/purchase or exchange activity conversation using source number/meaning relationships; remove hints and compare error evidence, not a band.

foundation_speaking.train: Activate familiar words; model present simple/frequency, collocations and short answer plus reason; rehearse intelligible third-person endings.
foundation_speaking.transfer: Unseen personal routine/family questions using own short notes; record/review relevance, intelligibility and useful extensions.

intermediate_listening.train: Predict gap category, decode quantities/dimensions and explain why a repeated detail does not answer a reason question.
intermediate_listening.transfer: Recombine source property/service information into bounded note completion and reason-sensitive alternatives; explain distractor decisions afterward.

intermediate_speaking.train: Group topic vocabulary, retrieve model language, generate question ideas and contrast WH/why/would responses with lexical stress.
intermediate_speaking.transfer: Newly worded hometown/accommodation questions derived from the selected source content, with reduced scaffolding; own explanation and targeted feedback.

advanced_listening.train: Contrast near synonyms, preserve exact spoken answer, decode conventions and track delayed corrections and condition/result meaning.
advanced_listening.transfer: Adapt source moving-service note/MCQ information (the source itself transfers from museum booking); no transcript or coaching during attempt, retrospective evidence review.

advanced_speaking.train: Analyze question function, develop support across Part2/3, control future time clauses and sentence stress.
advanced_speaking.transfer: Reword source city/rural long-turn and urban-change discussion sequence to test source prediction/comparison/cause/hypothesis with formative rubric evidence.

design.shared_mock: Use one common assessment contract across pathways with equivalent mode, timing, answer visibility, content-version pinning and teacher-reviewed task specifications. Training scaffolds are absent during mock attempts. These selected Unit1 pages do not constitute a full Listening mock blueprint (all four parts), calibrated difficulty, scoring rules or band conversion; obtain wider source and current official specification evidence before finalizing.
design.ux_ax_dx: Keep source IDs/page references in internal provenance; give learner primary task instructions and meaningful feedback. Lesson schema should separate prerequisites, model noticing, guided production, independent transfer and feedback evidence.
design.semantic_requirement: Train and transfer tasks must stay within source-derived semantic content/scenarios and preserve source-backed relationships; transfer changes support and question construction, not into unrelated invented subject matter.
